tagline: Leading materials science company serving high-growth markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric reflecting overall commercial performance and Dow's sensitivity to economic cycles and supply-demand dynamics
company_description: Dow Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides various materials science solutions for packaging, infrastructure, mobility, and consumer applications in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, India, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The company operates through Packaging & Specialty Plastics, Industrial Intermediates & Infrastructure, and Performance Materials & Coatings segments. The Packaging & Specialty Plastics segment provides ethylene, propylene, polyethylene, and aromatics products; and other ethylene derivatives, such as polyolefin elastomers, ethylene vinyl acetate, and ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber. The Industrial Intermediates & Infrastructure segment offers polyurethanes, including propylene oxide, propylene glycol, and polyether polyols; aromatic isocyanates and fully formulated polyurethane systems; and chlor-alkali and vinyl comprising chlorine and caustic soda, ethylene dichloride, and vinyl chloride monomer; and construction chemicals consisting of cellulose ethers, redispersible latex powders, and acrylic emulsions, as well as coatings, adhesives, sealants, elastomers, and composites. risks.title: Macroeconomic Recession
risks.summary: Economic recession could further deteriorate sales and profitability, particularly given existing demand weakness
risks.score_rationale: Company explicitly references macroeconomic uncertainty and supply-demand dynamics as factors impacting sales across all segments and regions. 7% revenue decline demonstrates direct exposure to economic cycles. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Competitive market dynamics could erode market share and price realization
risks.score_rationale: Company operates in competitive markets with local price declines driven by supply-demand dynamics, indicating pricing pressure and margin compression risk (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.summary: Regulatory changes could increase operational costs and constrain manufacturing flexibility
risks.score_rationale: Company subject to environmental and safety regulations; no material regulatory violation disclosed but ongoing compliance costs represent operational risk (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Credit Rating Downgrade
risks.summary: Credit rating downgrade would increase cost of debt financing and limit financial flexibility
risks.score_rationale: Company's financial leverage and declining earnings create risk of credit rating downgrade, which would increase borrowing costs and access constraints (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.summary: Commodity price fluctuations directly impact production costs and profitability
risks.score_rationale: Primary exposures to natural gas, crude oil, ethylene and propylene feedstocks create significant margin volatility that cannot always be hedged effectively (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.summary: Asbestos litigation and other legal proceedings could result in material financial liabilities and reputational damage
risks.score_rationale: Company (through Union Carbide) faces ongoing asbestos litigation with 7,158 unresolved claims as of Dec 31, 2025, increasing from 5,813 in 2024 (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.summary: Reputational damage could affect customer relationships and investor confidence
risks.score_rationale: Asbestos liabilities and environmental regulations create ongoing reputational exposure that could impact stakeholder confidence (default score, to be refined)
